title: Lesson: why some instructions are 16 bits (the C extension)
description:
Feature: Compressed instructions
  Scenario: The explorer shows a 16-bit instruction in real firmware
    Given a firmware disassembly containing a compressed instruction
    Then the instruction is shown as 2 bytes with its expansion to the 32-bit form
right_now_summary: The lesson explains how compressed instructions appear as 16-bit code and expand to 32-bit forms.
